    """Parse markup in to an iterable of tuples of (position, text, tag).

    Args:

    position = 0
    _divmod = divmod
    _Tag = Tag
    for match in RE_TAGS.finditer(markup):
        full_text, escapes, tag_text = match.groups()
        start, end = match.span()
        if start > position:

        if escapes:

            if backslashes:
